description: [CD34] Aménagement cyclables en site propre du Conseil Départemental de l’Hérault is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by herault.fr. All the cycling facilities on the Hérault Departmental Council’s own site. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[CD34] Bicycle development on the own site of the Conseil Départemental de l’Hérault" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2014-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
